publicBeta.welcome: Welcome to CompassCAD NEXT Public Beta!

segments.body_segment1: Welcome to the CompassCAD NEXT Desktop Public Beta! We're proud that you are here!
segments.body_segment2: Before you can get started, we'd like to warn you of the following things.

warns.doNotDailyDrive: Please do not daily drive this version of CompassCAD yet.
warns.lotsOfBugs: Keep in mind that there will be LOTS OF BUGS, incomplete/unfunctional buttons.
warns.missingFeatures: There will be a LOT of missing features/buttons than desktop/web.
warns.noSettingChange: There are no ways for you to change settings (as of now). If you want to, you'll need to get hacky.
warns.alternative: If you want somewhere to still daily drive, use CompassCAD Desktop (< 2.1.0) or the web.

segments.askForConsent: With that out of the way, let's start by checking "I Consent" and then closing this popup.
segments.checkListConsent: I consent that there will be bugs and I will be responsible for design losses.
segments.riskAccepted: Risk accepted. We won't show you this dialog, but please beware. You're entering dangerous beta territory.

settings.title: Settings
settings.fontHelp: Font face applies to drawing text. Font size applies to new labels.
settings.error: Could not save settings. Your changes have not been applied.
settings.invalidSize: Font size must be between 1 and 256.
settings.gridHelp: Custom spacing in drawing units: 1 drawing unit = 1 cm. Also available in the toolbar.
settings.unitsHelp: Changes measurement labels and toolbar units without scaling geometry. Inspector coordinates remain in drawing units (cm).
settings.undoHelp: Maximum saved states (10–500). Lower limits take effect on the next edit.
settings.invalidNumbers: Check the numeric settings: grid spacing 0.01–100000 cm, selection tolerance 1–50 px, decimal places 0–6, and undo history 10–500.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.help: Uncheck an extension to deactivate it when you save. Enabling an extension requests consent before its code runs. Permissions apply to this activation only.
extensions.canvas: Canvas access is always available. OS access is limited to the permissions listed above.
extensions.consent: Before activating {name}, {name} would like to request some permissions from you:

permissions.web_request: Web requests: send and receive HTTP(S) data, including Internet and local network addresses.
permissions.server_listen: Local server: host up to four HTTP servers on 127.0.0.1. Other programs on this computer can connect.
permissions.filesystem_read: Read files: read text files and list folders anywhere your account can access.
permissions.filesystem_write: Write files: create or overwrite text files, create folders, and delete files anywhere your account can access.
